dedupe_keys.name: a simplified procedure for the accurate frequency response identification of voltage transformers

description: Crotti, G. and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The method combines a rated-voltage 50 Hz ratio-error measurement with a low-voltage frequency sweep up to the first resonance. A nonlinear fitted model reconstructs the medium-voltage transformer frequency response from these inputs. Coverage includes characterisation of a commercial transformer and validation against a rated-voltage reference procedure at INRIM. It uses sine-wave generation for both steps. The source does not identify every fitted parameter or prove that the same approximation works for all transformer constructions. Zenodo supplies the descriptive publication with open access under cc-by-4.0. The publication does not establish public access to an implementation or its separate licence. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations. The fitted model supports transformer frequency-response identification.
